title: UGM Master's Student in Agricultural Engineering Participates in International Joint Supervision Program at Wageningen University & Research
excerpt: Wageningen, Netherlands — Muhammad Athala Fawwaz Dzaky, a master's student in the Agricultural Engineering Study Program, Faculty of Agricultural Technology, Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), and member of the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SARC), Department of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering FTP UGM, participated in a student mobility activity at Wageningen University & Research (WUR),…
body:
**Wageningen, Netherlands —** Muhammad Athala Fawwaz Dzaky, a master's student in the Agricultural Engineering Study Program, Faculty of Agricultural Technology, Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), and member of the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SARC), Department of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering FTP UGM, participated in a student mobility activity at Wageningen University & Research (WUR), Netherlands, on 1–12 September 2026. This activity is part of the International Joint Supervision Program (IJSP), a joint supervision program that provides students with the opportunity to gain academic and research experience at partner international universities.

Through this program, Athala received supervision from Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho as his advisor from UGM and Dr. Joseph Peller as his advisor from WUR. Dr. Andri also accompanied the implementation of activities during the stay in Wageningen. Athala also had the opportunity to consult with Prof. Gerrit Polder regarding spectral imaging technology and its application in agricultural research.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1032-1-image-9-1030x773.webp)

The main agenda of the activity included research supervision, laboratory practice implementation, scientific discussions, and guidance in manuscript writing for submission to international journals. This series of activities was designed to strengthen the quality of student research while providing experience in conducting research according to international academic standards.

At WUR's Vision + Robotics Laboratory, Athala studied spectral imaging technology and its application for plant phenotyping. By utilizing the equipment and systems available in the laboratory, he gained direct experience in understanding the use of spectral imaging to observe plant characteristics objectively and accurately. This technology has great potential to support the development of precision agriculture and smart farming systems.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1032-2-image-10-1030x773.webp)

Joint supervision sessions also provided a space for Athala to discuss research progress, review the methods used, and improve how to present research results scientifically. Manuscript writing guidance helped Athala organize research results more systematically as part of preparation for publication in international journals.

Beyond academic and research activities, Athala had the opportunity to experience life as a student at WUR. He learned about the campus environment, educational and research facilities, academic culture, and patterns of interaction among students and researchers. This experience provided direct insight into the learning and research ecosystem at one of the world's leading universities in the field of agriculture.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1032-3-image-11-773x1030.webp)

For Athala, the opportunity to study at WUR was one of his dreams. He views WUR as being at the forefront of developing modern agriculture, particularly indoor farming supported by cutting-edge technology. Therefore, the opportunity to study this field directly was an invaluable experience. Athala also gained a deep impression from direct supervision by professional researchers, both when conducting research practice in the laboratory and when learning the process of systematic and high-quality scientific writing.

The implementation of this IJSP strengthens academic cooperation between UGM and WUR, particularly in the fields of agricultural technology, spectral imaging, and plant phenotyping. The cross-institutional supervision program also opens opportunities for students to build international networks, enhance scientific communication skills, and develop understanding of education and research at the global level.

Athala's participation in this program is expected to motivate other UGM Agricultural Engineering students to actively seek international academic experience and prepare themselves for further studies at leading universities worldwide. This activity also supports the Sustainable Development Goals, particularly SDG 4 on Quality Education, SDG 9 on Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure, and SDG 17 on Partnerships to Achieve the Goals.

original.title: Mahasiswa Magister Teknik Pertanian UGM Ikuti International Joint Supervision Program di Wageningen University & Research
original.excerpt: Wageningen, Belanda — Muhammad Athala Fawwaz Dzaky, mahasiswa Program Studi Magister Teknik Pertanian, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian, Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), sekaligus bagian dari Smart Agriculture Research Center (SARC), Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem FTP UGM, mengikuti kegiatan student mobility di Wageningen University & Research (WUR),…
original.body:
**Wageningen, Belanda —** Muhammad Athala Fawwaz Dzaky, mahasiswa Program Studi Magister Teknik Pertanian, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian, Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM), sekaligus bagian dari Smart Agriculture Research Center (SARC), Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem FTP UGM, mengikuti kegiatan _student mobility_ di Wageningen University & Research (WUR), Belanda, pada 1–12 September 2026. Kegiatan ini merupakan bagian dari International Joint Supervision Program (IJSP), sebuah program pembimbingan bersama yang memberikan kesempatan kepada mahasiswa untuk memperoleh pengalaman akademik dan penelitian di perguruan tinggi mitra internasional.

Melalui program tersebut, Athala memperoleh pembimbingan dari Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho sebagai pembimbing dari UGM dan Dr. Joseph Peller sebagai pembimbing dari WUR. Dr. Andri turut mendampingi pelaksanaan kegiatan selama di Wageningen. Athala juga berkesempatan berkonsultasi dengan Prof. Gerrit Polder mengenai teknologi pencitraan spektral dan penerapannya dalam penelitian pertanian.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1032-1-image-9-1030x773.webp)

Agenda utama kegiatan meliputi pembimbingan penelitian, pelaksanaan praktik laboratorium, diskusi ilmiah, serta pendampingan dalam penulisan manuskrip untuk diajukan ke jurnal internasional. Rangkaian kegiatan ini dirancang untuk memperkuat kualitas penelitian mahasiswa sekaligus memberikan pengalaman dalam menjalankan riset sesuai standar akademik internasional.

Di Laboratorium Vision + Robotics WUR, Athala mempelajari teknologi _spectral imaging_ dan penerapannya untuk _plant phenotyping_. Dengan memanfaatkan peralatan dan sistem yang tersedia di laboratorium, ia memperoleh pengalaman langsung dalam memahami penggunaan pencitraan spektral untuk mengamati karakteristik tanaman secara objektif dan akurat. Teknologi tersebut memiliki potensi besar untuk mendukung pengembangan pertanian presisi dan sistem pertanian cerdas.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1032-2-image-10-1030x773.webp)

Sesi supervisi bersama juga menjadi ruang bagi Athala untuk mendiskusikan perkembangan penelitian, meninjau metode yang digunakan, serta memperbaiki cara menyajikan hasil penelitian secara ilmiah. Pendampingan penulisan manuskrip membantu Athala menyusun hasil riset secara lebih sistematis sebagai bagian dari persiapan publikasi pada jurnal internasional.

Selain mengikuti kegiatan akademik dan penelitian, Athala mendapatkan kesempatan untuk merasakan kehidupan sebagai mahasiswa di WUR. Ia mempelajari lingkungan kampus, fasilitas pendidikan dan penelitian, budaya akademik, serta pola interaksi antara mahasiswa dan peneliti. Pengalaman tersebut memberikan gambaran langsung mengenai ekosistem pembelajaran dan penelitian di salah satu universitas terkemuka dunia dalam bidang pertanian.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1032-3-image-11-773x1030.webp)

Bagi Athala, kesempatan belajar di WUR merupakan salah satu impiannya. Ia menilai WUR berada di garis depan dalam pengembangan pertanian modern, khususnya _indoor farming_ yang didukung teknologi mutakhir. Karena itu, kesempatan untuk mempelajari bidang tersebut secara langsung menjadi pengalaman yang sangat berharga. Athala juga memperoleh kesan mendalam dari pembimbingan langsung para peneliti profesional, baik ketika melaksanakan praktik penelitian di laboratorium maupun ketika mempelajari proses penulisan ilmiah yang sistematis dan berkualitas.

Pelaksanaan IJSP ini memperkuat kerja sama akademik antara UGM dan WUR, khususnya dalam bidang teknologi pertanian, _spectral imaging_, dan _plant phenotyping_. Program pembimbingan lintas institusi juga membuka peluang bagi mahasiswa untuk membangun jejaring internasional, meningkatkan kemampuan berkomunikasi secara ilmiah, dan mengembangkan wawasan mengenai pendidikan serta penelitian di tingkat global.

Keikutsertaan Athala dalam program ini diharapkan dapat memotivasi mahasiswa Teknik Pertanian UGM lainnya untuk aktif mencari pengalaman akademik internasional dan mempersiapkan diri melanjutkan studi di perguruan tinggi terkemuka dunia. Kegiatan ini sekaligus mendukung Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan, khususnya SDG 4 tentang Pendidikan Berkualitas, SDG 9 tentang Industri, Inovasi, dan Infrastruktur, serta SDG 17 tentang Kemitraan untuk Mencapai Tujuan.
